description.text: The major is designed to train professionals with basic knowledge of management, economics, law, and marketing, who can to get engaged in marketing activities with the capability of research, decision-making, resilience, and pioneering. They should be familiar with the characteristics and operation of the market rules of the industry (particularly the information industry).Graduates are competent for such position as marketing and management in enterprises, institutions and government departments (focusing on the telecommunications industry), and teaching and research as well. The major is featured with information technology, so graduates find their jobs mainly in the areas of telecommunications industry. Teachers of the major are experienced with strong research capacity. All the teaching and training activities are carried out from the perspective of marketing, which fully embodies marketing thinking that "ability" takes the priority. For a marketing personnel, efficiency, performance, effectiveness consist of the whole work. Students are trained for the target of marketing positions, with an innovative model, by implementing and supporting the requirements of marketing. Skills are emphasized in the teaching System, course content, and teaching methods, all of which are two innovative. Students in the first 2 years are trained in accordance with Business Administration as a largest category for a theoretical basis, and at the third school year they can finish their follow-up coursed in accordance with their own choice of specialties.

duration.text: The Marketing at Chongqing University of Posts and Telecommunications is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript 5.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: With senior high school diploma and HSK certificate of level 4 or above
